function: CSI compression and reconstruction (feedback) with a CSINet+ autoencoder trained on digital-twin ray-tracing CSI, plus fidelity analysis and refinement with limited real data (pp. 1, 8).
system: FDD single-cell massive MIMO: BS with 32-antenna ULA, single-antenna UEs; OFDM with 256 subcarriers at 30 kHz spacing; 3.5 GHz band; no RIS (pp. 3, 9, 10).
method: CSINet+-based autoencoder (encoder at UE, decoder at BS), supervised NMSE training on digital-twin data, then fine-tuning with rehearsal and NMSE-based data selection (pp. 7-8).
data_channel: Training: digital-twin CSI; testing: target CSI. Both from Wireless InSite ray tracing of Downtown Boston with DeepMIMO channel generator; baselines DeepMIMO O1 and WINNER II (p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained on digital-twin data (no foliage), DeepMIMO O1 or WINNER II; tested on unseen target-site data with foliage; refined on a small target subset (pp. 10-12).
baselines: No classical compressor; uncompressed-CSI reference (p. 14). Learned: the same CSINet+ trained on DeepMIMO O1, WINNER II or target data; naive fine-tuning versus rehearsal (pp. 10-14).
metrics: NMSE of CSI reconstruction; compression ratio 1/64 to 1/8; F1-score of building geometry; sum spectral efficiency with zero-forcing precoding (pp. 6, 10, 14).
complexity: Encoder parameter size 0.26 MB, decoder 0.36 MB; refinement converges within 200 iterations (pp. 9, 12); no FLOPs or runtime.
q1_support: p. 10: "with the DeepMIMO channel generator [48]". All CSI is generated from ray-tracing path parameters this way; the Boston scene is custom and DeepMIMO O1 is only a baseline training set.
q2_support: p. 10: "trained on different amounts of synthetic data and tested on the target dataset". A fine-tuning adaptation with few target samples is also reported (p. 12).
q3_support: p. 10: "we evaluate the following two baseline scenarios". These are the same CSINet+ model trained on DeepMIMO O1 or WINNER II data; no non-learned compressor and no earlier published learned CSI feedback model is compared.
q4_support: p. 9: "the CSINet+ model adopted in our work has an encoder parameter size of 0.26 MB and a decoder parameter size of 0.36 MB". Size in MB only; no FLOPs or runtime.
q5_support: p. 10: "We employ Wireless Insite [41] to perform accurate 3D ray tracing between the BS and all UE positions in the target, digital twin, and baseline scenarios". Custom scenes; no code or dataset link or DOI in the paper.
notes: Area 2: the learned function is CSI compression and reconstruction (p. 4); the digital twin only supplies training data. q1 borderline, reviewer to confirm: no 3GPP model; channels come from Wireless InSite ray tracing of a custom Boston scene converted with the DeepMIMO channel generator (p. 10), and DeepMIMO O1 and WINNER II appear only as baseline training sets. q2: direct transfer from digital twin to target data and refinement with few target samples (pp. 10-12). q3: baselines are variants of the same model trained on other data, so none counts as an earlier learned method, and no classical compressor is compared. q4 borderline: parameter size in MB (p. 9) is the only cost reported. q5: DeepMIMO O1 trains a baseline only; the main data are custom and unreleased.
